equation_assessment.geometry: With B=F D^-1 full row rank, V=B^+(Y-a s^T) minimizes the weighted coefficient norm. Orthogonal projection onto B^+a gives J0 and center; the remaining budget gives radius sqrt((rho^2-J0)/(a^T C a)). Independent rectangular SVD and 70-digit arithmetic agree.
equation_assessment.unboundedness: Fc=a gives U_lambda=U0-lambda c v^T and s_lambda=s0+lambda v. This preserves actual Y at all tested amplitudes and proves the unrestricted coefficient-class obstruction. No positive-emissivity realizability is inferred.
equation_assessment.noise: For blocks Sigma_i and fixed l_i, scalar variance is at most (sum sqrt(l_i^T Sigma_i l_i))^2 by Cauchy-Schwarz. A shared scalar plus independent residual blocks attains it. Summing separate coordinate variance maxima gives a valid, generally loose trace bound even though the coordinate maxima need not be attained jointly. Markov on the Euclidean norm squared then proves the displayed simultaneous radii conditional on zero means and released marginal variances.
equation_assessment.complex_TV_and_Taylor: The absolute-amplitude/positive-intensity distinction is correct. The 1/6 third-order integral remainder is valid on an admitted convex domain with a finite derivative envelope and TV bound. No numerical remainder is claimed absent these inputs.
equation_assessment.boundary: The zero-radius point is the algebraically constructed rho_min boundary; no arbitrary input radius below J0 was admitted or clipped. This does not supersede inherited unresolved-boundary guards.
equation_assessment.units_frame: Thermodynamic K_CMB amplitudes and squared noise units; Galactic COSMO Q+iU and canonical sqrt(2) real coordinates match the independent harmonic implementation. Metric signature and c are retained metadata without spurious dynamical use.

input_hold_assessment.reason: Finite positive upper functionals can bound complex-emission TV, but calibrated source confidence and nonnegative response domination on every target atom have not been established. Negative noisy spectra cannot be clipped to zero. The nearest-centre diagnostic proves neither missing physical sky nor an actual lower-response envelope.
input_hold_assessment.weaker_sufficient_input: A valid full-sky absolute integral with a conservative flux/operator norm, or a nonnegative aggregate response lower bound, suffices; an exact beam reconstruction is not required.

input_hold_assessment.reason: A hard compact domain is sufficient rather than logically necessary. Tail-moment constraints or a direct response bound can replace it. Existing numerical parameter cutoffs and projected map scatter do not calibrate the required LOS moments. In the unrestricted normalized MBB continuation, T can tend to infinity while finite-band ratios remain bounded and the R32 t^2 moment diverges; some physical temperature/tail input is meaningful.

The reused common-response F tensor I24 is explicitly conditional, while native maps have different beams/pixel responses. A physical source bound needs its response transported to the target or a conservative operator norm. Neither a low-ell beam scalar nor the small different-fit SMICA residual supplies this bridge.
input_hold_assessment.weaker_sufficient_input: A direct native-band positive-intensity bound with controlled response norms may bypass common-response deconvolution.
